description: Set your rating on a song, album, playlist, music video or station (catalog or library id): love, dislike, or none to clear it. Always sends the rating (Apple's reads can lag its writes); returns the previous rating as read and verifies the new one. Needs APPLE_MUSIC_USER_TOKEN or web-player mode.

rating.description: love, dislike, or none to remove your rating.

type.description: What the id is: catalog types (songs, albums, …) or library-* types for library ids.

name: apple_music_set_rating
title: Love or dislike an Apple Music item
